## EA Media Tools 2.6.1 - jaguar

### Streaming quality

- Streaming now uses NVENC CQ 31 for 4K and 1080p sources.
- Streaming now uses NVENC CQ 32 for 720p, 360p, and other lower-resolution output.

### Audio reliability

- Encoded audio now uses timestamp-aware asynchronous resampling so source timestamp gaps and overlaps do not become audible choppiness.
- Surround downmix coefficients are normalized before compression instead of receiving an additional 1.8x gain.
- A latency-compensated lookahead limiter now guards compressed audio peaks against clipping and static-like distortion.

[Review changes since v2.6.0](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.6.0...v2.6.1).
